03 — Experience

The Paper Store
Senior Business Data Analyst — BI & Category
April 2024 — Present

Connecting financial planning, BI and strategy in one system.

Challenge

A $30M+ business portfolio needed scalable, timely intelligence across Sales, Inventory and Store Profitability — with budgeting, forecasting and expense management for $20M+ in operational spend depending on manual, fragmented reporting.

Approach

  • Prepared and analyzed income statements — identifying key revenue drivers, cost trends and profitability opportunities for executive decision-making
  • Designed automated Power BI dashboards across Sales, Inventory and Store Profitability functions
  • Led budgeting, forecasting and financial planning for $20M+ in operational expenses
  • Managed Opex and Capex tracking, cost analysis and optimization
  • Conducted operating expense variance analysis to identify financial gaps and improve budget adherence
  • Built driver-based forecasting and enhanced financial models with cross-functional teams
  • Developed automated data models and BI solutions integrating ERP and CRM sources (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, BW · Snowflake · Azure Data)
  • Leveraged advanced SQL and analytical techniques for business analysis and ad-hoc reporting
  • Standardized IRI and SPINS syndicated datasets; automated workflows with Microsoft Fabric and Copilot
  • Partnered with Finance, Sales, Operations and Leadership on forecast alignment, data accuracy and performance management

Impact

  • 93% forecast accuracy achieved across strategic planning for a $30M+ business portfolio
  • 80% reduction in manual reporting effort through automated Power BI dashboards, enabling real-time performance visibility
  • 8–10% reduction in controllable expenses from cost analysis and optimization opportunities
  • 15% improvement in forecast accuracy via enhanced financial models and driver-based forecasting
  • 30% reduction in reporting workload from automated ERP/CRM data models and BI solutions
  • Improved budget adherence and corrective-action planning through variance analysis
  • Executive dashboards and analytical frameworks monitoring KPIs, financial performance and growth opportunities
  • Transformed complex business data into actionable insights for leadership teams
